title: Run one cell, or a custom run (POST /sessions/<id>/run)
description: No command field exists on purpose: the controller builds the command from the record's cells and the validated flags (schemas/cells.json, ALLOWED COMMAND). Two forms. CELL: {cellId, flags?, addedKnobs?}. CUSTOM (the card's Custom run tab, owner 2026-11-15): {custom: {steps, knobs, name?}, addedKnobs?} where `steps` is one or more route step ids in route order (a sequence runs in order and stops at the first non-zero exit), `knobs` maps a step id to {flag: value} for that step's knobs (same validation per step), and `name` is a label of at most 60 characters. A custom run is a pair (stepIds, knobValues): the controller composes every command from the record, never from client text. Answers {runId} (HTTP 202); 400 with a message for an unknown cell or step, a bad flag, a bad added knob; 409 while another run is active in the session; 404/410 for an unknown or ended session.

step.description: the step the flag belongs to (its cell)
